pp2.3:36.4: jiṇṇampi kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ ratana paḷiveṭhanaṃ vā karonti, gandhakaraṇḍake vā naṃ nikkhipanti.
pp2.3:37.1: evameva tayo kāsikavatthūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu.
pp2.3:37.3: navo ce’pi bhikkhu hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo idamassa suvaṇṇatāya.
pp2.3:37.4: seyyathāpi taṃ kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ vaṇṇavantaṃ tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:37.5: ye kho panassa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭhānugati āpajjanti tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
pp2.3:37.7: seyyathāpi taṃ kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:37.8: yesaṃ kho pana patigaṇhāti cīvarapiṇḍapāta senāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tesaṃ taṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsaṃ.
pp2.3:37.10: seyyathāpi taṃ kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ mahagghaṃ tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:38.2: thero ce’pi bhikkhu hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo idamassa suvaṇṇatāya.
pp2.3:38.3: seyyathāpi taṃ kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ vaṇṇavantaṃ, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo
pp2.3:38.4: ye kho panassa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti. tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya,
pp2.3:38.6: seyyathāpi taṃ kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:38.7: yesaṃ kho pana patigaṇhāti’ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ. tesaṃ taṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsaṃ.
pp2.3:38.9: seyyathāpi taṃ kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ magagghaṃ, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:39.1: evarūpo ca thero bhikkhusaṅghamajjhe bhaṇati, tamenaṃ bhikkhu evamāhaṃsu
pp2.3:39.2: appasaddā āyasmanto hotha, thero bhikkhu dhammañca vinayañca bhaṇatīti.
pp2.3:39.3: tassa taṃ vacanaṃ ādheyyaṃ gacchati gandhakaraṇḍake’va na kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ,
pp2.3:39.4: ime tayo kāsikavatthūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu.
pp2.3:40.2: idhe’kacco puggalo uddhato hoti unnalo capalo mukharo vikiṇṇavāco muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto asaṃvutindriyo.
pp2.3:41.2: idhe’kacco puggalo anuddhato hoti anunnalo acapalo amukharo avikiṇṇavāco upaṭṭhitasati sampajāno samāhito ekaggacitto saṃvutindriyo.
pp2.3:42.2: idhe’kacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
pp2.3:43.1: katamo ca puggalo na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo:
pp2.3:43.2: idhe’kacco puggalo hīno hoti sīlena samādhinā paññāya.
pp2.3:43.3: evarūpo puggalo na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo aññatra anuddayā, aññatra anukampā.
pp2.3:44.1: katamo ca puggalo sevitabbo, bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo:
pp2.3:44.2: idhekacco puggalo sadiso hoti sīlena samādhinā paññāya,
pp2.3:44.5: sīlasāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ sīlakathā ca no bhavissati sā ca no phāsu bhavissati. sā ca no pavattanī bhavissati.
pp2.3:44.6: samādhi sāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ samādhikathā ca no bhavissati. sā ca no phāsu bhavissati, sā ca no pavattanī bhavissati.
pp2.3:44.7: paññāsāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ paññākathā ca no bhavissati. sā ca no phāsu bhavissati, sā ca no pavattanī bhavissati.
pp2.3:44.8: tasmā evarūpo puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:45.1: katamo ca puggalo sakkatvā garukatvā sevitabbo, bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo
pp2.3:45.2: idhe’kacco puggalo adhiko hoti sīlena samādhinā paññāya.
pp2.3:45.3: evarūpo puggalo sakkatvā garukatvā sevitabbo bhajitabbo, payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:45.5: aparipūraṃ vā sīlakkhandhaṃ paripūressāmi, paripūraṃ vā sīlakkhandhaṃ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmi,
pp2.3:45.6: aparipūraṃ vā samādhikkhandhaṃ paripūressāmi, paripūraṃ vā samādhikkhandhaṃ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmi.
pp2.3:45.7: aparipūraṃ vā paññākkhandhaṃ paripūressāmi, paripūraṃ vā paññākkhandhaṃ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī’ti.
pp2.3:45.8: tasmā evarūpo puggalo sakkatvā garukatvā sevitabbo, bhajitabbo, payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:46.1: katamo ca puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo:
pp2.3:46.2: idhe’kacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño, abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño anto pūti avassuto kasambujāto
pp2.3:46.3: evarūpo puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo. na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo’
pp2.3:46.5: kiñcāpi evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati atha kho naṃ pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati
pp2.3:46.7: seyyathāpi nāma abhi gūthagato kiñcāpi na daṃsati atha kho naṃ makkheti,
pp2.3:46.8: evameva kiñcāpi evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati atha kho naṃ pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati
pp2.3:46.10: tasmā evarūpo puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:47.1: katamo ca puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo:
pp2.3:47.2: idhe’kacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo appampi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccañce pātukaroti,
pp2.3:47.3: seyyathāpi nāma duṭṭhārukā kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭitā bhiyyosomattāya assandati, evameva idhe’kacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo appampi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati, patitthīyati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti,
pp2.3:47.4: seyyathāpi nāma tindukālātaṃ kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalayā vā ghaṭṭitaṃ bhiyyosomattāya cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati,
pp2.3:47.5: evameva idhekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo appampi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti,
pp2.3:47.6: seyyathāpi nāma gūthakūpo kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyosomattāya duggandho hoti,
pp2.3:47.7: evameva idhekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appampi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patitthīyati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti,
pp2.3:47.8: evarūpo puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:47.10: akkoseyyapi maṃ paribhāseyyapi maṃ anatthampi me kareyyāti,
pp2.3:47.11: tasmā evarūpo puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo, na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:48.1: katamo ca puggalo sevitabbo, bhajitabbo, payirupāsitabbo:
pp2.3:48.5: kiñcāpi evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
pp2.3:48.7: tasmā evarūpo puggalo sevitabbo, bhajitabbo, payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:49.1: katamo ca puggalo sīlesu paripūrakārī samādhismiṃ mattasokārī paññāya mattasokārī:
pp2.3:49.3: ime vuccanti puggalā sīlesu paripūrakārino, samādhismiṃ mattasokārino, paññāya mattasokārino.
pp2.3:50.1: katamo ca puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī, samādhismiñca paripūrakārī paññāya mattasokārī:
pp2.3:50.3: ayaṃ vuccati puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī samādhismiñca paripūrakārī, paññāya mattasokārī.
pp2.3:51.1: katamo ca puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī, samādhismiñca paripūrakārī, paññāya ca paripūrakārī:
pp2.3:51.3: ayaṃ vuccati puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī samādhismiñca paripūrakārī, paññāya ca paripūrakārī.
pp2.3:52.2: idhe’kacco satthā kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na rūpānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti.
pp2.3:52.3: idha pana ekacco satthā kāmānañca pariññaṃ paññāpeti. rūpānañca pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti,
pp2.3:52.4: idha pana ekacco satthā kāmānañca pariññaṃ paññāpeti, rūpānañca pariññaṃ paññāpeti vedanānañca pariññaṃ paññāpeti.
pp2.3:53.1: tatra yvāyaṃ satthā kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na rūpānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti rūpāvacarasamāpattiyā lābhī satthā tena daṭṭhabbo
pp2.3:53.2: tatra yvāyaṃ satthā kāmānañca pariññaṃ paññāpeti rūpānañca pariññaṃ paññāpeti na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti arūpāvacarasamāpattiyā lābhī satthā tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.3:53.3: tatra yvāyaṃ satthā kāmānañca pariññaṃ paññāpeti, rūpānañca pariññaṃ paññāpeti, vedanānañca pariññaṃ paññāpeti, sammāsambuddho satthā tena daṭṭhabbo,
pp2.3:54.2: idhekacco satthā diṭṭheceva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti, abhisamparāyañca attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti
pp2.3:54.3: idha pana ekacco satthā diṭṭheva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti, no ca kho abhisamparāyaṃ attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti,
pp2.3:54.4: idha pana ekacco satthā diṭṭheceva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato na paññāpeti. abhisamparāyañca attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti.
pp2.3:55.1: tatra yvāyaṃ satthā diṭṭheceva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti, abhisamparāyañca attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti sassatavādo satthā tena daṭṭhabbo,
pp2.3:55.2: tatra yvāyaṃ satthā diṭṭhe’va dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti no ca kho abhisamparāyaṃ attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti ucchedavādo satthā tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.3:55.3: tatra yāvāyaṃ satthā diṭṭheceva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato na paññāpeti. abhisamparāyañca attānaṃ saccato thetato na paññāpeti. sammā sambuddho satthā tena daṭṭhabbo,
